summary: This bill establishes a new tax credit for the domestic production of high-performance rare earth magnets, with higher credit amounts for magnets made from predominantly U.S.-produced rare earth materials, and phases out the credit after 2037.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a new tax credit for the domestic production of rare earth magnets. While structured as a tax credit, it effectively represents a government expenditure in the form of foregone tax revenue to incentivize specific industrial activity. The elective payment option further solidifies this as a direct government outlay.

The bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to create a new tax credit, which directly impacts the tax liabilities of eligible manufacturers. This credit reduces the amount of tax owed by businesses that produce rare earth magnets domestically.
